description: Refuses two things to subagents only: a background command, and a git command that would overwrite uncommitted work in a tracked file (git restore, git checkout with a pathspec written with or without a --, and git checkout or git switch carrying a force, patch or --pathspec-from-file option). The main conversation is never denied.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\nworkstreams: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.ts"; exit 0
